title: Malaysia cumulative mean revenue loss
limitations: Historical input provenance is incomplete; assessment is available for inspection only and cannot be recomputed.
Estimates are conditional on the ENSO event and are not causal attributions; risk is defined as neutral revenue minus event revenue, with gains retained in signed means.
Scope covers agriculture, forestry and fishing value added with conditional government revenue transmission; it is not a total-economy loss and not a sovereign default probability.
Values are expressed in constant 2025 USD, GDP-deflated, at a fixed 2025 exchange rate; price and exchange-rate responses are not modeled.
